# architecture-scan: readChangedFiles is hand-duplicated in 3 scripts/ci gates outside the canonical mutation-gate-inputs.ts seam

> Surfaced by `/hydra-architecture-scan` on 2026-09-21 against the Orchestrator (~/hydra).
> Composed on the upstream `improve-codebase-architecture` Explore phase, headless.

## Files in scope

- scripts/ci/scope-check.ts (readChangedFiles, lines 270-276; call site line 320)
- scripts/ci/target-risk-core-check.ts (readChangedFiles, lines 76-82; call site line 133)
- scripts/ci/stryker-scan.ts (readChangedFiles, lines 374-380+, the git-diff-fallback variant)
- src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts (the existing canonical seam - readChangedFiles / parseChangedFiles, lines 69-116)

## Problem

src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts already exists specifically to stop this exact duplication class: it unified scripts/ci/mutation-check.ts and scripts/target/mutation-check.ts (issues #2393 Orchestrator / #1821 Target, unified by #4346) behind one readChangedFiles() export that reads CHANGED_FILES through parseChangedFiles. Both mutation-check gates already import it cross-directory (scripts/target/mutation-check.ts imports ../../src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts), proving the seam is a real, adopted adapter, not a hypothetical one.

Despite that precedent, three more scripts/ci/ gates independently reimplement the identical body instead of importing the canonical function:

    const env = process.env.CHANGED_FILES ?? "";
    return env.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.length > 0);

- scope-check.ts:270-276 - byte-identical duplicate. scope-check.ts is a required CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml:319, scope-check:), so every PR pays this drift risk.
- target-risk-core-check.ts:76-82 - byte-identical duplicate.
- stryker-scan.ts:374-380+ - a third, still-uncentralized variant that adds a useful git diff fallback (falls back to git merge-base origin/master HEAD when CHANGED_FILES is empty) that the canonical seam and the other two copies don't have.

Four independent copies of "parse CHANGED_FILES into a file list" now exist with three different behaviors (bare split, bare split, split-with-git-fallback) and no mechanism keeping any of them in sync - the exact "hand-duplicated instead of imported" pattern this repo has already paid down once for the mutation-check pair (#4346) and for route-helpers.ts's schema-validation-failed contract (#4572).

## Solution (plain English - no interface design yet)

Route scope-check.ts and target-risk-core-check.ts through the existing readChangedFiles() export in src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts instead of their local copies (delete the two local function bodies, add the import - the same shape scripts/target/mutation-check.ts already uses to reach cross-directory into src/). For stryker-scan.ts, evaluate folding its git-diff-fallback behavior into mutation-gate-inputs.ts itself (e.g. an optional fallback parameter) so the more capable variant becomes the one canonical implementation all four call sites share, rather than leaving it as a third drifted copy.

## Benefits (locality + leverage + tests)

- Locality: "how does a CI gate learn which files changed" lives in one place (src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts) instead of four independently-evolving copies across scripts/ci/ and src/.
- Leverage: a future gate that needs the changed-files list gets the (potentially git-diff-fallback-capable) canonical version for free, instead of a fifth copy-paste.
- Tests: src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts's own parsing edge cases (empty env, CRLF, whitespace-only lines) only need covering once; scope-check.ts and target-risk-core-check.ts currently have to duplicate that same test surface (or, more likely, don't).

## Deletion test

Deleting the three local readChangedFiles() copies and importing the canonical one concentrates the "parse CHANGED_FILES" logic into the single module already built to hold it (src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts) - it does not just move complexity to a caller, since the canonical seam already exists, is already imported cross-directory by two other gates, and each duplicate has exactly one call site (scope-check.ts:320, target-risk-core-check.ts:133) with no other logic mixed in.

## Files out of scope

- The Untouchable Core (src/untouchable.ts protected paths: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/deploy.yml, .github/workflows/deep-qa-gate.yml, scripts/tier-classify.ts, src/tier-classifier.ts, src/untouchable.ts itself) - this change only imports from src/mutation-gate-inputs.ts and edits scripts/ci/scope-check.ts, scripts/ci/target-risk-core-check.ts, and optionally scripts/ci/stryker-scan.ts; it does not touch any workflow YAML or the tier classifier.
- scripts/ci/mutation-check.ts and scripts/target/mutation-check.ts - already migrated (#4346), no change needed.
